# RuleBlast

> Git diff for repository instructions. Shows the blast radius of AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md changes across Codex, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, and Copilot CLI.

RuleBlast answers the problem query: which files inherit a changed AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md? Git shows the first diff. RuleBlast shows the second.

- Repository: https://github.com/Kpoiut/ruleblast
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/ruleblast
- Problem page: https://github.com/Kpoiut/ruleblast/blob/main/which-files-inherit-agents-md.md
- Sealed case: 2 instruction-line edits → 206 Codex stacks — https://github.com/Kpoiut/ruleblast/blob/main/PROOF.md
- CLI: npx --yes ruleblast@2.3.0 .
- This tree is 2.3.1: OTHER TRACKED CHANGES, WORK MAP, CHANGE ALIGNMENT on human Git-pair and Git→WORKTREE diff. Not actor telemetry. Published npm remains 2.3.0.

Local. Read-only. Deterministic. Not a claim about model compliance.
